# AI Prompt Vault Pro — Quick Start

Thank you for purchasing AI Prompt Vault Pro!

## How to Use This Vault

1. Open **AI-Prompt-Vault-Pro-500-Prompts.md** in any text editor or Markdown viewer
2. Find the section you need (use Ctrl+F to search)
3. Copy the prompt
4. Replace [BRACKETED PLACEHOLDERS] with your specifics
5. Paste into ChatGPT, Claude, or any LLM

## Organization

- Section 1: Coding & Development (80 prompts)
- Section 2: Marketing & Growth (100 prompts)
- Section 3: Business & Strategy (80 prompts)
- Section 4: Content Creation (100 prompts)
- Section 5: Sales & Copywriting (80 prompts)
- Section 6: Productivity & Life (60 prompts)
- Bonus: Power Prompts (30 advanced prompts)

## Tips for Best Results

- Always provide context in the [BRACKETED] sections
- Claude responds best to role-based prompts ("You are a...")
- ChatGPT 4o handles multi-step prompts well
- For long outputs, add "respond in sections" to any prompt
